title: Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure for Subsurface Seepage Forecasting and Relief Placement
abstract: arXiv:2611.31125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Truncating a large heterogeneous diffusion model around a localized, threshold-activated outlet saves degrees of freedom but severs exterior feedback that governs when the outlet opens and how much it discharges. By separating forcing-driven background head from local withdrawal drawdown, Site-Conditioned Boundary Closure (SCBC) maps local physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at the cut boundary. Supervised on unforced donor-domain withdrawal responses, these coefficients yield a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes across unseen forcing histories without refitting. We evaluate SCBC on flood-driven subsurface seepage beneath levee foundations against full-grid reference simulations (MODFLOW~6). Across three held-out foundation panels, a single frozen SCBC tree estimator reduced peak-discharge log RMSE by 26.1%, 30.9% and 42.6% relative to identical local patches using a shared boundary coefficient. translated_title: 面向地下渗流预报与减压设施布置的场地条件化边界闭合方法
translated_abstract: 将大型非均质扩散模型在局部阈值激活的渗流出口附近进行截断，虽然可以节省自由度，却切断了决定出口何时开启及其出流量大小的外部反馈。场地条件化边界闭合方法通过将外部驱动力形成的背景水头与局部抽取引起的降深相分离，把局部物理描述量映射为截断边界处的正交换系数。这些系数以无外力供体域的抽水响应作为监督进行训练，从而得到一个保持无源性的降阶算子，能够在未见过的外力历史下泛化而无需重新拟合。我们在堤防地基下洪水驱动的地下渗流问题上对SCBC进行评估，并与全网格参考模拟（MODFLOW 6）进行对比。在三个留出的地基面板上，单个冻结的SCBC树估计器相比使用共享边界系数的相同局部补丁，将峰值出流量的对数RMSE分别降低了26.1%、30.9%和42.6%。
tldr: SCBC方法将局部场地物理特征映射为截断边界上的正交换系数，构建出保持无源性、无需重新拟合即可跨外力历史泛化的降阶算子，在堤基渗流预测中将峰值出流误差较共享边界系数方法降低约26%–43%。
en_tdlr: SCBC maps local site physical descriptors to positive exchange coefficients at truncated model boundaries, yielding a passivity-preserving reduced operator that generalizes to unseen forcing histories without refitting, and cuts peak-discharge errors by roughly 26–43% over shared-coefficient baselines in levee seepage forecasting.
